title: Derived projection isomorphism for proper-support complexes
statement: Let S be Noetherian, f:X -> S locally of finite type, and E bounded with coherent cohomology and all cohomological supports proper over S. For every quasi-coherent O_S-module F there is an isomorphism Rf*E tensor^L F[0] ≅ Rf*(E tensor^L Lf*F[0]). No relative Tor condition is imposed.

source.place: Tag 08EV, support reduction and first displayed equality; Tag 08EU

proof.text: Boundedness leaves the integer interval [a,b]. Choose the closed proper support in each degree of that interval, enumerate it by Fin, and apply finite proper-support union. Its reduced closed subscheme is compact over the Noetherian base. Shrink its closed immersion to a compact open U containing the union; outside the interval all stalks vanish by functorial zero preservation.

Construct a localization on U with morphisms in the ambient universe: its standard derived direct image is fully faithful, so its hom sets are small because D(X) has small hom sets. Shrink the standard localization using Mathlib hasLocalizationOfLocallySmall. Apply the supported-open tensor direct-image comparisons for E and K=F[0].

Local finite type over the Noetherian base makes X locally Noetherian. Coherent cohomology is quasi-coherent; exact restriction preserves this property. The degree-zero single object F[0] is quasi-coherent by its homology computation and zero homology in other degrees.

The compact open U is locally Noetherian, hence quasi-separated. Its map to S is qcqs. Apply the qcqs projection isomorphism on U, tensor the E comparison with the identity of F[0], and compose with the inverse tensor-input comparison.

theorem nonempty_properSupport_derivedProjection_iso
    (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian S]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace))]
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory X)
    (hbounded : ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, i < a ∨ b < i →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) i).obj E))
    (hcoherent : ∀ i : ℤ,
      RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) i).obj E))
    (hsupport : ∀ i : ℤ,
      Scheme.Modules.HasSupportProperOver f
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) i).obj E))
    (F : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace)) (hF : F.IsQuasicoherent) :
    Nonempty (((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj E) ⊗
        (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F ≅
      (schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj
        (E ⊗ (derivedPullback f).obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F)))
